body: closes https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCalibrate.jl/issues/380 - This PR adds a latitude weighting diagonal term. The main benefit is to allows users to add latitude weighting to their own custom observation recipes. There is also a marginal benefit in simplifying the observation recipes for the `ScalarCovariance` and `SeasonalDiagonalCovariance` matrices.
title: Add latitude weighting diagonal term

body: This PR removes the `SeasonalDiagonalCovariance` observation recipe which is not used right now. Help with closing https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCalibrate.jl/issues/387.
title: Remove SeasonalDiagonalCovariance
